name: uci-tabular-successor-v1
claim_ceiling: fresh licensed development and one-time public validation for byte-exact delimited records and dense feature matrices; not private-holdout, independently reproduced, universal, market-leading, or state-of-the-art evidence

provider.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
provider.attribution_policy: Retain each dataset DOI, creator citation, source page, acquired archive SHA-256, selected member, exact item SHA-256, evaluation track, and original byte syntax in every manifest.

contamination_policy.allowed_use: The retained first score may motivate the declared record-table and dense-feature-matrix evaluation strata. No consumed bytes, sampled statistics, family identities, header spelling, codec deltas, or fitted threshold may train, select, or gate a successor.
contamination_policy.production_routing: Track labels and dataset metadata are evaluation-only. A production selector may use only bounded bytes from the current input and complete framed candidate sizes where practical.

archive_integrity_policy.state: publisher pages expose licenses, member names, and sizes but not archive digests
archive_integrity_policy.development: Commit this unopened corpus declaration first. The first development acquisition records archive and exact selected-item SHA-256 values before any codec probe.
archive_integrity_policy.public_validation: Do not acquire, inspect, list archive members, sample, or score until a successor candidate, selector, gates, runner, and evaluator are frozen. Retain the first authorized attempt whether it passes, fails, or is interrupted.

selection.slice_rule: After archive extraction and any declared member decompression, retain the complete file when it is at most max_item_bytes. Otherwise retain the longest prefix of at most max_item_bytes that ends immediately after LF. Do not parse, normalize, transcode, reserialize, collapse whitespace, add a header, or change line endings.
selection.member_rule: Match the complete normalized archive member path exactly. Reject duplicate, absent, absolute, parent-traversing, symbolic-link, or non-regular members.
selection.item_rule: One selected publisher member is one benchmark family and one exact byte stream. Publisher-provided train labels describe provenance only and do not make an item project validation data.

private_holdout.policy: No dataset names, URLs, bytes, digests, headers, shapes, or derived statistics are stored in the public repository.
